# Check for data races when concurrently building test variants of a cgo package.

[short] skip
[!cgo] skip

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env GOTMPDIR=$WORK/tmp
mkdir $WORK/tmp
go test -run=^$ ./...
go run ./checkwork $GOCACHE $GOTMPDIR

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27
-- checkwork/main.go --
// checkwork reports files in a directory tree that mention a string.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	root, s := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	bad := false
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return err
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if bytes.Contains(data, []byte(s)) {
			fmt.Printf("%s mentions %s\n", path, s)
			bad = true
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if bad {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- c/c.go --
package c

// int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
import "C"

import (
	_ "example.com/m/x1"
	_ "example.com/m/x2"
	_ "example.com/m/x3"
	_ "example.com/m/x4"
	_ "example.com/m/x5"
	_ "example.com/m/x6"
	_ "example.com/m/x7"
	_ "example.com/m/x8"
)

func Add(a, b int) int { return int(C.add(C.int(a), C.int(b))) }
